subject: general
question: Who has been appointed as the Chairman and Managing Director (CMD) of Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) in 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lalit Kumar Gupta.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The Cotton Corporation of India (CCI) is **Public Sector Undertaking established in1970**.
 
• It helps in implementing various policy, to promote **the interests of cotton growers, ensuring fair market practices, and stabilizing the cotton market in India. **
 
• It is governed by a Board of Directors, which includes representatives from the Ministry of Textiles, Government of India, and experts from the cotton industry.
 
• their goals include **Enhancing Cotton Quality and Yield,** **Supporting Farmers,** **Market Expansion.**
